samples.question: Inside the cyan 12 by 12 grid, first invert the top-left cell and every other cell in both directions, making a checkerboard pattern of inverted cells. Then form a new grid: in each row, make a cell black exactly when the number of black cells from the left edge through that cell is odd; otherwise make it white. Which symbol appears: diamond, hourglass, left fan, or right fan?
